db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Bulk Insert Billing Records
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processed_billing ( id, customer_id, account_number, billing_period_start, billing_period_end, usage_amount, rate_plan_id, base_rate, subtotal, tax_rate, tax_amount, total_amount, currency, status, processed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( :id, :customerId, :accountNumber, :billingPeriodStart, :billingPeriodEnd, :usageAmount, :ratePlanId, :baseRate, :subtotal, :taxRate, :taxAmount, :totalAmount, :currency, 'PROCESSED', :processedAt, NOW() )
db:bulk-insert.db:bulk-input-parameters: #[payload map { id: $.id, customerId: $.customerId, accountNumber: $.accountNumber, billingPeriodStart: $.billingPeriodStart, billingPeriodEnd: $.billingPeriodEnd, usageAmount: $.usageAmount, ratePlanId: $.ratePlanId, baseRate: $.baseRate, subtotal: $.subtotal, taxRate: $.taxRate, taxAmount: $.taxAmount, totalAmount: $.totalAmount, currency: $.currency, processedAt: $.processedAt }]

logger.doc:name: Log Bulk Insert Success
logger.message: #["[DEBUG] Billing records bulk inserted successfully | Count: " ++ sizeOf(payload)]
